title: When a gym membership ends, the gym's workout plan just says 'No longer sent', with no word on why or that renewing brings it back
what: Workout plans a gym gives to everyone on a membership plan reach the member only while that membership covers today. The day it ends, the folder on the Workout tab changes to 'No longer sent by <gym>'. The same words are used when the trainer withdraws the plan, so the member cannot tell that the membership ending caused it, or that renewing brings it back (it does: renewing updates the folder again).
expected: When the plan stopped because the membership ended, the line says so and points to renewing at the gym.
how_often: every membership that ends while a plan-wide workout plan is assigned
fix_line: Have the gym's answer say the membership ended, and show 'Your membership ended. Renew at the desk to get this plan again.'

items.reason: no payment, price or billing call in this area; a search of every file for price, billing, payment, refund, receipt, GST, credits and Plus found none (both listed features are free workout-plan features)
no amount is typed or shown in this area; the only gym link is the 'From <gym>' line on workout plan folders
